def transform(grid):
    """Mark background cells whose 180-degree rotational counterpart is foreground."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = grid[0][0]
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value != bg]
    if not cells:
        return out
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, _ in cells), max(r for r, _ in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for _, c in cells), max(c for _, c in cells)
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
            rr, cc = r0 + r1 - r, c0 + c1 - c
            if grid[r][c] == bg and grid[rr][cc] != bg:
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
